int32_t track_duration

Length of the current track in 0.01-second resolution.

  • Zero or greater.

  • Track Duration Characteristic Value Unknown : No current track or the duration of the current track is unknown.

int32_t track_position

Current track position of the current track in 0.01-second resolution.

Offset from the start of the track to the current playing position.

  • 0: Starting position or start of the track is not well defined.

  • Track Position Characteristic Value Unavailable : No current track or the start of the track is not well defined.

  • Other values.
